body.purpose: The workhorse: list items, descriptions, most UI text.

label.purpose: Button text, form labels, active nav.

shadows.name: control-edge
shadows.purpose: Chalk's resting shadow (shadow-xs) on buttons and inputs. Reads as a crisp edge, not a lift.

shadows.name: enterprise-elevation
shadows.purpose: Enterprise's semantic elevation foundation; use the existing shadow scale rather than one-off values.

motion.name: transition-all
motion.purpose: Default state transition on buttons and interactive controls (hover, focus).

motion.name: transition-color-shadow
motion.purpose: Input focus transition (border/ring), avoiding layout properties.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Default solid action button; 36px compact height.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; height: 36px; padding: 0 16px; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; border: none; border-radius: 8px; background: var(--primary, oklch(0.2038 0.0264 260.9332)); color: var(--primary-foreground, oklch(0.9851 0 0)); box-shadow: 0 1px 2px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / 0.05); cursor: pointer; transition: all 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--primary, oklch(0.2038 0.0264 260.9332)) 90%, transparent); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklab, var(--ring, oklch(0.6503 0.022 257.4949)) 50%, transparent); }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Secondary bordered button on the base surface.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; height: 36px; padding: 0 16px; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; border: 1px solid var(--border, oklch(0.9013 0.0156 257.2001)); border-radius: 8px; background: var(--background, oklch(0.9745 0.0079 253.8524)); color: var(--foreground, oklch(0.1443 0.0191 261.1564)); box-shadow: 0 1px 2px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / 0.05); cursor: pointer; transition: all 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: var(--accent, oklch(0.9442 0.0137 258.3455)); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklab, var(--ring, oklch(0.6503 0.022 257.4949)) 50%, transparent); }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Single-line field; border-shift plus 3px ring on focus.
components.css: .ds-input { display: flex; width: 100%; height: 36px; padding: 4px 12px; font-size: 0.875rem; border: 1px solid var(--input, oklch(0.9013 0.0156 257.2001)); border-radius: 8px; background: transparent; color: var(--foreground, oklch(0.1443 0.0191 261.1564)); box-shadow: 0 1px 2px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / 0.05); outline: none; transition: color 150ms, box-shadow 150ms; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--muted-foreground, oklch(0.5195 0.0188 262.6912)); } .ds-input:focus-visible { border-color: var(--ring, oklch(0.6503 0.022 257.4949)); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklab, var(--ring, oklch(0.6503 0.022 257.4949)) 50%, transparent); }

narrative.overview: DevTrees is an instrument panel for parallel development. Every surface is a readout or a control: worktree lists, branch/PR status, session history, launch buttons. Information density is high but never chaotic; the developer scans it at a glance and reaches for the right control by reflex. Built on shadcn/ui (new-york) with selectable Chalk and Enterprise palettes, each supporting light and dark modes, color stays functional while elevation follows the active theme.
keyCharacteristics: Two restrained palettes: Chalk and Enterprise, coordinated across light and dark
Compact 36px controls and 0.875rem body text with theme-specific radii
Chalk uses flat tonal layering; Enterprise adds deliberate soft elevation
One semantic token contract across every palette and mode
3px focus rings on every interactive element; keyboard-first

rules.name: The Semantic Accent Rule
rules.body: Use the selected theme's primary color for actions, focus, and current selection rather than decoration; reserve red for destructive and error states.

rules.name: The Weight-Not-Family Rule
rules.body: Distinguish UI hierarchy with weight (400/500/600) and muted foreground; reserve mono for developer content and serif for explicitly styled content.

rules.name: The Theme-Depth Rule
rules.body: Establish hierarchy with tonal layering first, then apply only the active theme's semantic shadow scale.

dos: Do keep controls compact: 36px height and text-sm, with theme-defined radii.
Do establish depth with tonal layering, then use the active theme's semantic shadows.
Do reserve saturated color for state (red for destructive only).
Do distinguish UI hierarchy with weight and muted foreground; reserve mono for developer content.
Do give every interactive element a visible 3px focus ring.
Do ensure body and placeholder text hit at least 4.5:1 across both themes and modes.
donts: Don't build heavy-enterprise density-without-clarity: no nested config panels, modal mazes, or Jira-style sprawl.
Don't drift toward consumer-chat softness: no oversized rounded bubbles, avatars, or playful decorative color.
Don't invent one-off shadows or use elevation without clear tonal hierarchy.
Don't use theme accents decoratively or use red for anything but destructive and error states.
Don't use serif or mono as decorative UI emphasis, or use gradient text.
Don't use side-stripe border-left accents on cards or list items.
